skill.summary: Shopee big data analytics and product selection agent. One-stop data service for Shopee sellers — product selection, competitive analysis, sales trend tracki...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Shopee Big Data Analytics: a comprehensive tool for sellers covering product selection, competition analysis, sales trends, marketing insights, and store optimization in Southeast Asian markets.
- Provides command-line tools for product research, trend analysis, competitor assessment, keyword research, marketing recommendations, price intelligence, market overviews, forecasting, and reporting.
- Includes detailed frameworks for market selection, Shopee algorithm ranking, opportunity assessment, competitive analysis, and marketing strategy.
- Offers guidelines on the key data to provide for actionable analytics, including product info, target market, competitor/shop data, and pricing details.
- Delivers structured output with market overviews, opportunity scoring, competitive landscape analysis, pricing guidance, keyword strategies, marketing calendars, and actionable entry roadmaps.
- Sets up an organized workspace for reports, research, and campaign data.
